name: Mpu6050 Read Periodic Display
description: Read the accelerometer and gyroscope data from the MPU6050 over I2C every 100 ms on a timer interrupt, average the readings over 10 samples, and display the averaged X-axis values on the LCD1602: the first row formatted printf-style as "Ax(g): %.2f" (acceleration in g) and the second row as "Gx(dps): %.2f" (angular rate in degrees per second).
